title: Google is reportedly renewing its assault on the iPhone X with a redesigned and upgraded Pixel 3 phone (GOOG, GOOGL, AAPL)
text: Google is reportedly renewing its assault on the iPhone X with a redesigned and upgraded Pixel 3 phone (GOOG, GOOGL, AAPL) By Avery Hartmans May 30, 2018, 5:11 pm 40 pts Google plans to release two new smartphones this year, the Google Pixel 3 and Google Pixel 3 XL, according to a report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
